scripts.build: npm install --prefix dashboard/frontend && npm run build --prefix dashboard/frontend && rm -rf dashboard/backend/public && cp -r dashboard/frontend/dist dashboard/backend/public && npm install --prefix dashboard/backend && npm run build --prefix dashboard/backend && npx --prefix dashboard/backend prisma generate --schema=dashboard/backend/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.start: npx --prefix dashboard/backend prisma db push --schema=dashboard/backend/prisma/schema.prisma && node dashboard/backend/dist/server.js
